identity_binding_policy: All legacy corpus identities and sense bindings remain unresolved; native identity alternatives are not corpus identity confirmations.
correspondence_policy: No lexical/sense-scoped normative correspondence bindings are supplied by the v5 input. UNKNOWN_NOT_EVALUATED does not mean no valid correspondence exists.
history_policy: Exact finite decisions retain original IDs and POS/sense scopes; incomplete historical coverage blocks application globally but is not a blanket negative.
pattern_policy: Observational mechanisms and risk flags are hypotheses for investigation, never linguistic deletion verdicts. Shared member sets do not imply synonymous or redundant families.
